summary: The A2A gate is correctly distinguishing mechanical DOMAIN_RECEIPTED proof from true semantic peer/model processing. The Hermes M5 path proves delivery, target-dock artifact publication, NATS publish acknowledgement, and reply capture, but the inspected receipts explicitly keep semantic_reply_claim=false and peer_model_processed_claim=false. The runtime scripts also preserve that distinction: generated target-dock artifacts default both claims to false, the domain reply worker copies the artifact's explicit flags into the domain receipt, and reply capture treats typed domain receipts as DOMAIN_RECEIPTED while deriving semantic_reply_claim only from the payload flags. This Codex workhorse artifact is a separate semantic review and must not be read as Hermes, Fable, Devin, or Claude semantic participation.
sharpest_disagreement: The current evidence should not be called semantic peer collaboration. target_owned_artifact_claim=true and DOMAIN_RECEIPTED are useful transport/domain ownership signals, but the actual Hermes M5 artifact was authored by a filesystem delivery handler and says it is not a Hermes model semantic reply. The semantic-peer gate remains open for Hermes/Fable/Devin until a target-owned model or workhorse runtime produces content with semantic_reply_claim=true or peer_model_processed_claim=true and supporting evidence.
missing_evidence: A target-owned Hermes/Fable/Devin or approved peer-workhorse artifact whose content demonstrates actual model semantic processing and explicitly sets semantic_reply_claim=true or peer_model_processed_claim=true.
Independent proof of peer runtime authorship beyond filesystem delivery handling, such as a causal AgentOps/A2A receipt chain tying the semantic artifact to the processing runtime identity.
A captured semantic reply or typed domain receipt that includes substantive critique, blocker, decision, or next-build analysis rather than only receipt/delivery metadata.
Operator-facing board/control-surface proof that the missing semantic-peer gate is visible with owner, missing evidence, receipt refs, and verifier commands.
highest_leverage_next_build: Build or activate one approved peer/workhorse semantic reply runner that consumes an AgentOps work packet through the existing A2A/ds-goal/BoardStore surfaces, performs real model review, writes a target-owned semantic artifact with semantic flags true only when actual model output exists, and publishes/captures it through the existing domain receipt path without creating a second bus or memory authority.
